ontology.title: K-Ontology - the psychological structure described by J. Krishnamurti
ontology.note: A map of the mechanism, not a path. The mechanism is modelled positively; what lies outside it appears only by negation (axiom A12). By axiom A13 this file is itself of thought, therefore limited, and can end nothing.
ontology.masterPartition: ofThought: true = a movement of thought (Construct, Movement, Affect); false = not of thought (Actuality, Perceiving, Flowering).

scales.note: How deeply a perception has landed. The same act of seeing occurs at any of these degrees; only 'profound' has any dissolving power (axiom A15). Applies to k:SeeingTheFalse and k:Insight.

steps.gloss: Agreement with the description. The word taken for the thing; nothing is actually perceived. Still a movement of thought.
steps.evidence: The word is not the thing; the description is not the described.

steps.gloss: The logic is followed and accepted as a conclusion. Conviction, not perception; no action follows from it.
steps.evidence: Verbal agreement or intellectual acceptance is not seeing.

steps.gloss: Actual perception, but partial or momentary - a glimpse that does not hold.
steps.evidence: The depth of that realisation may be very superficial.

steps.gloss: Total, non-verbal perception that alters the brain cells and changes the life. The only degree at which the dissolves and givesRiseTo edges fire.
steps.evidence: When it is profound it totally changes one's life.

terms.label: Entity
terms.gloss: Root of the ontology.

terms.label: Actuality
terms.gloss: What is the case prior to interpretation.

terms.label: Perceiving
terms.gloss: Capacities that are not activities of thought.

terms.label: Flowering
terms.gloss: What is there when the mechanism ends. Defined only by negation.

terms.label: Construct
terms.gloss: Anything thought has put together.

terms.label: Movement
terms.gloss: A process running in psychological time.

terms.label: Affect
terms.gloss: A psychological state the mechanism produces.

terms.label: Ground
terms.gloss: The substrate in which all of it occurs.

terms.label: Documentation
terms.gloss: The wiki's own layer: themes, quotes, sources, pathways, axioms.

terms.label: Fact
terms.gloss: What is actually going on, as against the idea of it.
terms.evidence: The fact is what is going on, what is happening.

terms.label: WhatIs
terms.gloss: The present state, not moved away from.
terms.evidence: 'What is' is so.

terms.label: Sensation
terms.gloss: Sense response prior to thought's image.
terms.evidence: If there was no thought there would be only sensation.

terms.label: TheNow
terms.gloss: The present, which contains past and future.
terms.evidence: All time, the past, the present and the future, is contained in the now.

terms.label: ChronologicalTime
terms.gloss: Clock time. Real, and not the subject of the inquiry.

terms.label: PhysicalNecessity
terms.gloss: Legitimate knowledge and skill: language, carpentry, getting from here to there.
terms.evidence: To learn a language needs time. That is not the time we are talking about.

terms.label: Image
terms.gloss: The picture thought makes of a person, thing or state.
terms.evidence: Thought creates the image, and at that moment desire is born.

terms.label: Ideal
terms.gloss: What should be. The opposite thought invents; always non-fact.
terms.evidence: Thought has created the opposite, which is non-fact.

terms.label: Self
terms.gloss: Me, ego - and equally the observer, thinker, controller, analyser, experiencer.
terms.evidence: The me is a series of conclusions: I believe, I am convinced, I have faith.

terms.label: Memory
terms.gloss: Remembrance of things past, held in the brain cells.
terms.evidence: We are nothing but memory, and it is to that memory that we are attached.

terms.label: Knowledge
terms.gloss: The outcome of experience. Always incomplete.
terms.evidence: Knowledge always lives within the shadow of ignorance.

terms.label: PsychologicalTime
terms.gloss: Tomorrow as inward achievement. Thought as time.
terms.evidence: Moving away from 'what is' to 'what might be' - that is psychological time.

terms.label: Belief
terms.gloss: A conclusion held for security, which then forbids examination.
terms.evidence: That attachment not only prevents further examination, but I am frightened to examine.

terms.label: Conditioning
terms.gloss: The program: nationality, religion, culture, generations of outside pressure.
terms.evidence: The constant assertion of the self is the movement, is the conditioning.

terms.label: Division
terms.gloss: Any inward split: me and you, observer and observed, fact and ideal.
terms.evidence: Where there is division there must be conflict.

terms.label: Illusion
terms.gloss: What is taken as real and is not. Separateness above all.
terms.evidence: The sense of separateness is an illusion. It is all one.

terms.label: Abstraction
terms.gloss: The idea of the fact. The word taken for the thing.
terms.evidence: The word 'suffering' is different from the actual suffering.

terms.label: Observer
terms.gloss: The one who looks - and is what is looked at.
terms.evidence: The observer is the observed.

terms.label: Thinker
terms.gloss: The one who thinks - and is the thought.
terms.evidence: The thinker is the thought.

terms.label: Controller
terms.gloss: The one who controls - and is the controlled.
terms.evidence: The controller is the controlled.

terms.label: Analyser
terms.gloss: The past examining the present - and is what it examines.
terms.evidence: The analyser is the analysed.

terms.label: Observed
terms.gloss: What is looked at - which is the looker.

terms.label: Controlled
terms.gloss: What is controlled - which is the controller.

terms.label: Analysed
terms.gloss: What is analysed - which is the analyser.

terms.label: Corruption
terms.gloss: What attachment invariably brings.
terms.evidence: Where there is attachment there is corruption.

terms.label: Thought
terms.gloss: The response of memory. A material process.
terms.evidence: Thought is the response of memory.

terms.label: Desire
terms.gloss: Sensation plus the image thought makes of it.
terms.evidence: Where there is sensation and the operation of the senses, thought creates the image, and at that moment desire is born.

terms.label: Will
terms.gloss: Desire hardened into direction. 'I will become that.'
terms.evidence: Will is the essence of desire. This action of will is part of our violence.

terms.label: Becoming
terms.gloss: The movement from what is toward what should be.
terms.evidence: This movement of becoming is the movement of thought in time.

terms.label: Comparison
terms.gloss: Measuring oneself against an image.
terms.evidence: Comparison is the movement of thought.

terms.label: Control
terms.gloss: One fragment attempting to master another it invented.
terms.evidence: When there is control, there are two entities: the one who is controlling, controlling that which he himself has created.

terms.label: Analysis
terms.gloss: The past examining the present, and so maintaining the split.
terms.evidence: Analysis implies an analyser, the analyser is the past, and he is examining the present.

terms.label: Attachment
terms.gloss: Clinging to an image, a person, a belief, the known.
terms.evidence: Where there is attachment I recognise, observe there is corruption.

terms.label: Escape
terms.gloss: Amusement, worship, entertainment, news, the scroll.
terms.evidence: We live with it, become accustomed to it, or escape from it - through amusement, through worship.

terms.label: Conflict
terms.gloss: The friction of any inward division.
terms.evidence: Conflict exists only when there is division.

terms.label: Violence
terms.gloss: Conflict expressed - and conflict as such.
terms.evidence: Conflict itself is violence.

terms.label: Continuity
terms.gloss: Trading one pattern for another and calling it change.
terms.evidence: I give up this pattern and take on another pattern.

terms.label: Fear
terms.gloss: Thought projecting loss forward. Fear is time.
terms.evidence: If I am to die now, immediately, there is no fear. But I want to live another ten years - so fear is time.

terms.label: Sorrow
terms.gloss: Not private. The common lot, long preceding the loss that reveals it.
terms.evidence: Sorrow is not yours or mine, it is sorrow.

terms.label: Pleasure
terms.gloss: Enjoyment turned into memory and then pursued.
terms.evidence: Remembered beauty is not beauty.

terms.label: Loneliness
terms.gloss: The isolation the self's own activity manufactures.
terms.evidence: We are attached because we are lonely - deep abiding loneliness which is suffocating.

terms.label: Jealousy
terms.gloss: What appears exactly where attention is absent.
terms.evidence: Where there is complete attention, there is no jealousy.

terms.label: FalseSecurity
terms.gloss: Safety sought in a house, a wife, a nation, a god, a belief.
terms.evidence: You are all externalising, giving me security in things in which there is no security.

terms.label: Disorder
terms.gloss: The self's intrinsic output.
terms.evidence: No structure of the self can make order.

terms.label: Observation
terms.gloss: Seeing without the translator, the word, the motive or the direction.
terms.evidence: Learn the art of observing - not translating what you observe, but just to observe.

terms.label: Attention
terms.gloss: Whole attention. No centre, no me; not concentration, not effort.
terms.evidence: Attention can only come into being when the self is not.

terms.label: Insight
terms.gloss: Immediate perception, out of time, which alters the brain cells.
terms.evidence: Insight being out of time, it is not the result of remembrance, it is not an intuition, or desire, or hope.

realizationDepth.note: The same perception occurs at any depth; only at 'profound' do its dissolves / givesRiseTo edges actually fire (A15). Verbal and intellectual degrees are still of thought (A8) and end nothing.

terms.label: SeeingTheFalse
terms.gloss: Perceiving the false as false - which is already the discovery of truth.
terms.evidence: To see the false as the false - which means you have already discovered what is true.

realizationDepth.note: The same perception occurs at any depth; only at 'profound' do its dissolves / givesRiseTo edges actually fire (A15). Verbal and intellectual degrees are still of thought (A8) and end nothing.

terms.label: SelfKnowing
terms.gloss: Learning about oneself moment to moment, without accumulating.
terms.evidence: Self-knowledge is not an accumulated process of knowledge. It is constant learning about oneself.

terms.label: Doubt
terms.gloss: The seed, allowed to flower - including doubt of one's own structure.
terms.evidence: Doubt your experiences, doubt your illusions, doubt the very structure of your thinking.

terms.label: Love
terms.gloss: Defined only by what it is not.
terms.evidence: Love is not knowledge. Love is not remembrance. Love is not desire or pleasure.

terms.label: Compassion
terms.gloss: The passion that is there when sorrow ends.
terms.evidence: The ending of sorrow is passion, not lust. And that is part of love.

terms.label: Intelligence
terms.gloss: May use thought; is not made of it. Free of the program. Neither the positive nor the negative of thought - it may appear once psychological thought has ceased (appearsOnCessationOf Thought).
terms.evidence: Intelligence can use thought, but intelligence itself is free from memory and knowledge.

terms.label: Freedom
terms.gloss: Ungraphed by design (A14). Zero incoming creates/givesRiseTo/opensInto/dissolves edges; the one edge it touches (Insight arisesFrom Freedom) runs Freedom -> Insight, never the reverse.
terms.evidence: It is only in freedom there is deep insight.

terms.label: Order
terms.gloss: Not arrangement. The absence of the self that disorders.
terms.evidence: Until we have established right relationship between us - which is order - how can I find that which is supreme order?

terms.label: Aloneness
terms.gloss: All-one. Whole, not fragmented.
terms.evidence: The word 'alone' means all one - together, whole, not fragmented.

terms.label: PsychologicalDeath
terms.gloss: Ending the content of consciousness while living.
terms.evidence: That consciousness with its content can be ended while I am living.

terms.label: TrueSecurity
terms.gloss: In intelligence only. Unavailable to the individual as individual.
terms.evidence: There is security only in intelligence. Individual can never have that security.

terms.label: Mutation
terms.gloss: Actual change in the brain cells through insight.
terms.evidence: There is a mutation in the brain cells. That mutation wipes out the whole structure that makes you suffer.

terms.label: Silence
terms.gloss: The quiet brain in which intelligence operates.
terms.evidence: Intelligence operates when the brain is quiet.

terms.label: Energy
terms.gloss: What is released when nothing moves away from what is.
terms.evidence: Moving away from 'what is' is wastage of energy.

terms.label: Brain
terms.gloss: Conditioned, material, a million years old - and not yours.
terms.evidence: Your brain has grown through a million years - it is not your brain, it is the common brain of man.

terms.label: Consciousness
terms.gloss: Identical with its content; common to mankind.
terms.evidence: The content of our consciousness is the common ground of all humanity.

terms.label: Mind
terms.gloss: Unconditioned. Has a relation to the brain; not the reverse.
terms.evidence: The mind being free has a relationship to the brain.

terms.label: Psyche
terms.gloss: What has no evolution.
terms.evidence: The evolution of consciousness is a fallacy. There is no psychological evolution.

terms.label: Humanity
terms.gloss: You, actually.
terms.evidence: Each one of us is actually the rest of humankind.

terms.label: Relationship
terms.gloss: Where all of this is testable. Usually two images.
terms.evidence: Relationship is between these two images. These images have been put together by thought.

terms.label: Society
terms.gloss: The self, externalised.
terms.evidence: I am society. I am the world.

relationTypes.label: projects
relationTypes.gloss: x throws y forward in time.

relationTypes.label: is identical with
relationTypes.gloss: Denies an assumed psychological duality. The strongest claim in the model: where the pair collapses, the division and so the conflict is gone.

relationTypes.label: is not
relationTypes.gloss: Negative definition. The only way Flowering terms are defined (axiom A12).

relationTypes.label: obscures
relationTypes.gloss: x prevents the seeing of y.

relationTypes.label: is limited by
relationTypes.gloss: x is bounded by y, and so is partial.

relationTypes.label: dissolves
relationTypes.gloss: x ends y - without effort and without time. By A8 no term with ofThought=true may appear as subject.

relationTypes.label: appears on the cessation of
relationTypes.gloss: Non-generative. x (a Flowering term) may be present where movement y has ceased; the ceasing neither causes nor entails x. Not oppositional like isNot, not causal like arisesFrom. Used only for Intelligence appearsOnCessationOf Thought.

relationTypes.label: common to
relationTypes.gloss: x belongs to the whole, not to a person.

axioms.label: Limitation
axioms.gloss: Whatever is of thought is limited, because knowledge is always incomplete.
axioms.evidence: Thought is limited because knowledge is limited.

axioms.label: Division
axioms.gloss: Whatever is limited defines a boundary, and so creates division.
axioms.evidence: If I define myself as limited, I am concerned with myself - that creates conflict.

axioms.label: Conflict
axioms.gloss: Division entails conflict, and conflict is itself violence. A private quarrel and a war are the same phenomenon at different scales.
axioms.evidence: Where there is division there must be conflict. Conflict itself is violence.

axioms.label: Non-duality
axioms.gloss: Every pair thought produces - observer/observed, controller/controlled, analyser/analysed - is one thing.
axioms.evidence: Both are the same, it is a trick played by thought.

axioms.label: Psychological time is a construct
axioms.gloss: Becoming runs in psychological time; psychological time is made by thought; therefore there is no psychological evolution.
axioms.evidence: Any form of becoming is an illusion, and the becoming implies time.
axioms.note: Thought and psychological time are not two structures joined by a homomorphism; on the psychological domain they are identical (K: 'thought is time'). A structure-preserving correspondence does hold - chaining of thoughts <-> composition of intervals; intentionality ('this should be that') <-> the direction of becoming; the self as common origin measuring WhatIs against WhatShouldBe <-> now measured against then; a thought as limit (A2) <-> an interval as gap - with the single metric Comparison (A10) on both sides. But identity is the stronger and correct reading: the movement of thought, seen as movement, is psychological time. The correspondence weakens to a mere restriction - nothing collapsed, a part set aside - only when technical thought is included, which runs in chronological time (PhysicalNecessity, ofThought:false). Positing 'two structures with a map between them' is itself the dividing move (A4: observer/observed, thinker/thought, time/thought are one), and drawing the diagram is one more Construct (A13). Corollary: 'improving psychologically over time' presupposes a pre-laid atlas to advance along; there is none - the re-charting is the time - so the project is Becoming (A5, P3), not a route out of it, and gradualism is thought postponing the ending it fears (A7).

axioms.label: Fact over idea
axioms.gloss: Only a fact can be acted on. An ideal can only be pursued, and pursuit is division - so pursuing non-violence manufactures the conflict it meant to end.
axioms.evidence: You can deal with the fact, but you cannot possibly do something about an idea.

axioms.label: Immediacy
axioms.gloss: Perception requires no time; therefore the ending is now, and gradualism is only more becoming.

axioms.label: Thought cannot undo itself
axioms.formal: not exists x ( ofThought(x) & dissolves(x, y) & Construct(y) )
axioms.gloss: Nothing of thought can dissolve what thought has constructed. This is why Perceiving must be disjoint from Movement: if attention were an activity of thought, nothing could ever end.
axioms.evidence: Thought, creating the problem, thought then tries to solve the problem. So it is caught in the same old process.

axioms.label: Commonality
axioms.gloss: Consciousness is common; the separate self is an illusion; private remedy for a private self is a category error.
axioms.evidence: Your consciousness is the consciousness of mankind, psychologically.

axioms.label: Measurement
axioms.gloss: The full chain, from a single glance at someone else's life.
axioms.evidence: Comparison is the movement of thought.

axioms.label: Attachment and corruption
axioms.gloss: Attachment entails corruption, fear and sorrow.
axioms.evidence: Where there is attachment I recognise, observe there is corruption.

axioms.label: Negation is the only positive
axioms.formal: Flowering(x) -> defined only by isNot edges
axioms.gloss: Flowering terms carry no positive predicate; they are defined by what they are not, and by what dissolves in their presence.
axioms.evidence: Love is not knowledge. Love is not remembrance. Love is not desire or pleasure.

axioms.label: Reflexive caution
axioms.gloss: This ontology is of thought, therefore limited (A1), therefore it can end nothing (A8). Its only legitimate use is as an object of SeeingTheFalse - checked against your own observation, then dropped.
axioms.evidence: There is no teacher, nor disciple. There is only learning, not learning what someone has to inform you, but learning in action.

axioms.label: Freedom is not a node you arrive at
axioms.formal: not exists x ( creates(x,Freedom) or givesRiseTo(x,Freedom) or opensInto(x,Freedom) or dissolves(x,Freedom) or arisesFrom(Freedom,x) )
axioms.gloss: No term, pathway, or axiom generates Freedom. Not an omission — the one place the model refuses to complete itself. Every other Flowering term still sits in a chain (Love opensInto Compassion opensInto Intelligence); Freedom is where the diagram simply declines the edge. What dissolves obstructs it; nothing constructs it. It is what remains, or is seen, when every drawable node has been drawn and the drawing itself is recognized as one more Construct and let go.
axioms.evidence: It is only in freedom there is deep insight. If you are not free to enquire, if you are biased, then you are limited.

axioms.label: Depth of realization
axioms.formal: depth(x) < profound -> ofThought(x) & not dissolves(x, _)   [x in {SeeingTheFalse, Insight}]
axioms.gloss: Seeing the false and insight admit a gradient from verbal agreement to profound perception. Only profound realization alters the brain cells; verbal and intellectual degrees are thought recognising a description, and by A8 dissolve nothing. This is why agreeing that thought is futile does not end thought.
axioms.evidence: The depth of that realisation, which may be very superficial, or it may be profound. When it is profound it totally changes one's life.

axioms.label: Enlargement does not close
axioms.formal: Open(ofThought) ; Construct ∪ Construct = Construct ≠ Actuality ; ∂(whole)=∅ when ¬SeparateSelf
axioms.gloss: A topological restatement of A1 + A8; asserts nothing new. The ofThought region is an open set: Construct joined with more Construct is still Construct, never Actuality. Completeness is not approached by accumulation - P1 runs in one direction and never converges inside the set. A boundary exists only against an outside (A2: a limit is a division); with no separate self drawing the inside/outside line (A9), the whole is clopen and its boundary is empty. The ending is therefore not the closure of the set (adding its boundary) but the collapse of the interior/boundary distinction itself (A4). Saying so is one more Construct (A13).
axioms.evidence: One's whole life is a movement within the field of the known.

axioms.label: The self is a non-compact cover
axioms.formal: Self = ⋃_{i∈ℕ} U_i, each U_i open ; Separateness -> no finite subcover (¬compact) ; chart-transition U_i->U_j = Becoming in PsychologicalTime ; countable -> personae enumerated one at a time ; residue X\⋃U_i ≠ ∅ is not a chart (A12)
axioms.gloss: Restates k:Division + k:Separateness + pathway P4 in the vocabulary of A16, and like A16 asserts nothing new. The self is not one region but an open cover of consciousness by countably many personae - each an open patch (a k:Image) with no crisp edge, defended precisely because it cannot locate its own limit (A2). The cover has no finite subcover: the self cannot be reduced to a fixed handful of roles, and k:FalseSecurity is exactly the demand for that missing finite subcover - 'let me be only these few settled things'. Moving between patches requires transition maps, and that movement is k:Becoming running in k:PsychologicalTime (A5); the restlessness between personalities is the self's mode of continuation, not an accident of it. The cover is countable - the personae are produced and traversed one at a time - so the enumeration is itself the becoming and never completes (A16). Where each patch is thin (nowhere dense: k:SeeingTheFalse at verbal or intellectual depth, A15) the union is meagre and cannot exhaust a complete space; the residue it never reaches is not one more persona but what profound k:SeeingTheFalse attends to. ofThought(this) = true (A13).
axioms.evidence: There is no security in isolation. This process of isolation is fragmentation.
axioms.note: The 'passage between charts' of A17 is the same movement A5 identifies with psychological time: chart-transition U_i -> U_j = Becoming = an interval of psychological time. The self as open cover and psychological time are therefore one structure under two descriptions - the atlas is not laid out in time; its re-charting is time.

pathways.label: The cycle of the known
pathways.gloss: Not stages: one unitary movement, always in the same direction.

pathways.label: The desire chain
pathways.exitAt: Thought creates Image - sensation is not the problem; sensation plus image is.

pathways.label: The becoming chain
pathways.exitAt: The second arrow. If there is no movement away from what is, there is no psychological time at all.

pathways.label: The self and its security
pathways.gloss: A closed loop: the search for security produces the insecurity it flees.

pathways.label: The relationship chain
pathways.gloss: The images relate; the people do not. Two railway lines running parallel.

pathways.label: The sorrow chain
pathways.gloss: Sorrow is not at the moment of losing somebody - it began long ago.

pathways.label: The ending
pathways.gloss: No method, no practice, no stages, no time. Every arrow here is simultaneity, not sequence - the one structural difference from P1-P6.

applications.label: Image & Becoming: the Instagram trap
applications.gloss: Comparison industrialised. Each scroll is an invitation to measure, and the misery itself feeds the self.

applications.label: War & spectacle
applications.gloss: The safe observer: A9 denied, division enjoyed as relief, Escape mistaken for information.

applications.label: Sensation & Image: why sex has become so important
applications.gloss: The last unborrowed door. Everything else is second-hand, so the whole weight of a thwarted life loads onto the one act where thought briefly subsides; P2 then converts it into image and pursuit, and A16 guarantees the pursuit never closes.
